output.summary: Dispute ticket volume doubled since August (E-02) driven by inaccurate bills from actual meter reads (E-04) while tariff unchanged (E-05) and ticket response times within SLA (E-01). Root cause hypothesized as incorrect billing import validation rule changes causing calculation errors (problem_definition).
key_points: Evidence shows volume increase (E-02), disputed bills mainly actual reads (E-04), no tariff changes (E-05), response times within SLA (E-01), and AMI read rejections indicating possible validation rule issues (E-10).
These observations support the hypothesis of rule change errors.
limitations_explained: The released capability monitors dispute ticket volume via DA-TICKET (solution_design.release_scope).
Audit of billing import validation rule changes (DA-RULES), bill recalculation (DA-BILL), and issuing corrected bills (SH-BILL) are deferred as VOB-U-U1 (verification_obligations.VOB-U-U1).
Thus the release proceeds with known limitation that root‑cause remediation is outside scope.
